Select: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie (efo_id), indication_label (efo_term), max_phase_for_ind. Source: molecule_dictionary, drug_indication. Join: molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Filter: max_phase_for_ind = 4 AND indication_label contains 'cancer' (case-insensitive). Sort: chembl_id ASC, pref_name ASC, canonical_smiles ASC, indication_curie ASC, indication_label ASC, max_phase_for_ind ASC.
